name: kalagh
description: Drive a Kalagh messaging provider — channels, contacts, chats, messages and media — over REST, Socket.IO or gRPC.
long_description: Every operation of a Kalagh provider (WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, email, …) as a tool. The tools are generated from the provider's own OpenAPI document, so they always match the provider you connect to. Pick REST, Socket.IO or gRPC as the transport. With a socket or gRPC endpoint configured, the provider's live events are buffered and readable through the events_recent tool. Sends and deletions are marked destructive, and read-only mode hides every tool that changes anything.

api_url.title: Provider REST URL
api_url.description: The provider's HTTP base, without /api/kalagh. Always required: the tool list, uploads and /storage downloads use it.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The provider's API_KEY. Stored in the operating system's keychain.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: http, ws or grpc — which protocol carries the operations. ws needs the Socket.IO URL, grpc needs the gRPC address.

ws_url.title: Socket.IO URL
ws_url.description: e.g. https://kalagh-ws.smg.tr. Needed for the ws transport; when set, provider events are also buffered for events_recent.

grpc_url.title: gRPC address
grpc_url.description: host:port, e.g. kalagh-grpc.smg.tr:443 (TLS is used on port 443). Needed for the grpc transport.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Expose only the tools that read. Nothing can be sent, edited or deleted.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where avatars, media and storage downloads are saved. Defaults to the system temp folder.
